# VAR

> VAR is VRT's integrated advertising platform offering omnichannel campaigns across radio, TV, digital, and podcast channels to reach Flemish audiences.

VAR (VRT Advertising & Revenue) is the advertising and media sales division of VRT, Belgium's public broadcasting company. It provides comprehensive advertising solutions spanning traditional and digital channels, with a focus on attention-driven, brand-building, and mission-oriented campaigns across Flanders.

## Key Topics

- VRT (Vlaamse Radio- en Televisieomroep)
- Omnichannel Marketing
- Radio Advertising
- Video Advertising

- Podcast Partnerships

## Core Advertising Solutions

- [Het VAR-effect: meer aandacht, meer merk, meer missie](https://www.var.be/nl): Dutch homepage showcasing VAR advertising platform and campaign benefits
- [Homepage](https://www.var.be/fr): French language homepage for VAR advertising platform and media services
- [Meer aandacht](https://www.var.be/nl/adverteren/meer-aandacht): Attention-focused advertising solutions via VRT radio and video platforms
- [Doelgroepen](https://www.var.be/nl/adverteren/meer-merk): Brand building and audience targeting via VRT omnichannel partnerships
- [Doelgroepen](https://www.var.be/nl/adverteren/meer-missie): Mission-driven social impact advertising via VRT omnichannel platforms

## Radio & Audio Advertising

- [Adverteren op VRT radio](https://www.var.be/nl/audio): Radio advertising packages across VRT stations reaching 90% of Flanders
- [Regionaal adverteren](https://www.var.be/nl/audio/regionaal-adverteren): Regional radio advertising via Radio 2 ProxiSpots across Flemish provinces
- [Podcast partnerships](https://www.var.be/nl/audio/podcast-partnership): Podcast sponsorship partnerships within VRT podcast network

## Television & Video Advertising

- [Adverteren op de TV-kanalen van de VRT](https://www.var.be/nl/video): TV advertising solutions across VRT channels and VRT NU digital platform
- [Nieuw: Total Content Partnership](https://www.var.be/nl/video/totalcontentpartnership): Multi-channel content partnership integrating brands with VRT TV, radio, MAX
- [VRT MAX (original) video partnership](https://www.var.be/nl/video/vrtmax-sponsoring): Video sponsorship partnerships with VRT MAX original series and programs
- [Boodschappen van Algemeen Nut](https://www.var.be/nl/video/ban): Public service messaging campaigns via VRT radio and television

## Creative Partnerships & Campaigns
